translations.web: (for when Gentiles who don’t have the law do by nature the things of the law, these, not having the law, are a law to themselves,
translations.bsb: Indeed, when Gentiles, who do not have the law, do by nature what the law requires, they are a law to themselves, even though they do not have the law.
translations.kjv: For when the Gentiles, which have not the law, do by nature the things contained in the law, these, having not the law, are a law unto themselves:
